promotion: Manual promotion only after held-out evaluation, never by training reward alone

stages.gate: Real camera nonconstant; no actor privileged-state leakage; finite states; free cube rests under gravity; zero-action robot stable

stages.cube: 26 original cubie meshes, locked layers, free rigid body
stages.gate: At least 90/100 held-out randomized episodes: BOTH hands contact cube, >=8cm lift, low speeds, no table support, continuous >=1s; check video and collision integrity

stages.task: long hold, regrasp and whole-cube reorientation
stages.gate: >=90% held for 5s and rotated to target within 10deg; enforce inter-hand collision and disturbance recovery
First validate free-core passive joint stability; then >=90% trials within 5deg, other-layer drift <5deg, no explosion/teleport, contact-only turning

stages.task: successive turns on two perpendicular faces
stages.gate: >=80% complete both turns without dropping; inspect cubie centers and orientation against discrete expected permutation

stages.task: vision facelet state estimation + active scan
stages.gate: Read all 54 facelets by repositioning cube; validate legal cube state and confidence; no simulator facelet input at inference
Planner consumes only visual state; command-conditioned manipulation policy executes and visually verifies each move; 1/2/5/10/20-move scramble evaluation separately

later_costs.regrasp: penalize loss of all support, joint speed, effort, inter-hand collision and time; reward contact distribution and object pose accuracy
later_costs.face_turn: reward decrease in target-layer angle error, penalize non-target-layer drift, center displacement and drop; success only from measured cubie transforms
later_costs.solve: minimize executed move count/time/recovery attempts; discrete planner supplies moves, RL controls physical execution
later_costs.vision: reject low-confidence or physically impossible facelet states; collect additional views instead of reading hidden state
